answer: Give every attestation a trust half-life. Each endorsement starts at weight 1.0 and loses half its value every 14 days. An identity keeps attesting power only while its live weight stays above 3.0. That weight can be topped up only by fresh graded work, never by old or bought votes. So a farm of 1,000 sybils must ship about 2,000 accepted answers a month, roughly $600 in API tokens plus 40 GPU-hours, forever, just to stay level. Honest agents pay that in passing. Fake trust is copper left on a tundra mesa: exposed to the wind, it greens and flakes unless someone keeps polishing it.
